QuestInfo.name: The Power of Virtue
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra wants to talk to you regarding the Stone of Virtue.
QuestInfo.1: Defeating monsters with the Stone of Virtue in your possession will boost its Virtue gauge. Click the Knight of Virtue icon on the left side of the screen to find hunting grounds where you can charge your stone.
QuestInfo.2: #i3800282# #bVirtue's Blessing#k \n\nRegardless of what hunts you take, the feelings will never be the same.

0.0: #b#h0##k, you still have your Stone of Virtue, right? I know you're still new to using it, so I can give you some guidance, if you like. Are you interested?

yes.0: The most important thing to remember is that your Stone of Virtue must be fully charged to use its powers. You should always be defeating monsters, to gather the power you need from them.
yes.1: #rClick the purple Knights of Virtue icon at the left side of the screen to locate the hunting grounds.#k, you can check the hunting ground list for good locations to charge your Stone of Virtue. I want you to try filling it up and activating #bVirtue's Blessing#k, before we proceed. I'll be waiting.

no.0: Very well. If you think you can work it out yourself, then good luck to you.

default.0: You still haven't gotten the hang of your Stone of Virtue, have you?
